tasks.short: Maintain and follow safe practice procedures

steps.what: Find the current standard quality, safety, environmental and infection control procedures in the controlled practice manual {DOCS}.
Follow those procedures during the actual care and workspace activities, checking conditions and correcting unsafe conditions in person.
inputs: Actual room, equipment and care situation
outputs: Observed completion or unresolved safety exceptions

steps.what: Write the actual required completion or exception entry in the practice quality log {OTHER}, checking it against what was observed.
Save that checked actual entry in the practice quality log {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure version-filtered links in the existing procedure library. The gain is finding the right current page, not performing or certifying infection control. Capture actual completion only after the work occurs.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated searches through superseded or poorly organised procedure pages.
tasks.enabler_now: Controlled-document filters and bookmarked current procedures.
tasks.still_hard: Applying procedures in changing physical conditions.
tasks.altitude: Physical care and safety accountability stay human.

evidence.claim: Controlled-document links can shorten repeated policy lookup while physical compliance remains manual.

assumptions: Unmeasured E1 allocation for work where current procedures are repeatedly located manually; existing effective links give zero saving.

The quality log is an actual existing requirement, not a new record per patient. Shares are averaged across applicable practice activities. Its writing is separate from in-person work and has no claimed saving.
s3 is ordinary entry production and checking. Its exact final version gates the fully retained save; no new self-approval stage is added. Completion cannot be inferred from an appointment ending.
No reportable incident occurs in this normal-completion path. An incident would require the actual applicable reporting workflow and its own gated send, outside this saving.
research_questions: Can staff locate the correct current procedure without opening obsolete copies?

already_counted.description: Procedure inspection, physical compliance, actual logging and saving remain counted.

incremental.description: Check controlled links after procedure updates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual quality-log entry checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 8 x 25% lookup reduction = 2 gross points less 0.5 upkeep; no physical or logging saving. E1, not a measured baseline.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Identify the local, state and federal laws, regulations and statutes relevant to the current practice question using the authoritative source collection {DOCS}.
outputs: Applicable source passages and unresolved applicability questions

steps.what: Adhere to the applicable requirements in the real practice situation, resolving scope or consent questions through the existing professional process before proceeding.
outputs: Compliant action or decision to pause and seek clarification

steps.what: Write and check any actual required scope, consent or compliance record in the practice record system {OTHER}.
inputs: Actual action and obtained consent or clarification

steps.what: Commit the exact checked required record to the practice record system {OTHER}.

tasks.design: No saving claimed. The work is applying requirements to real practice, not merely retrieving text. Keep source reading and real required record writing explicit. Existing bookmarks and forms are not evidence of new reducible work.
tasks.previous_blocker: Applicability depends on jurisdiction, scope and the specific situation.
tasks.enabler_now: No demonstrated change for this task beyond existing source and record access.
tasks.still_hard: Resolving ambiguous applicability and remaining within professional authority.
tasks.human_edge: Taking accountable action when generic rules do not settle the case.
tasks.altitude: Professional accountability remains with the practitioner.

evidence.claim: Applying professional requirements requires actual contextual judgment; generic retrieval does not establish adherence.

assumptions: US task wording is retained as the occupation's scope; actual practice uses its own jurisdiction. No specific current legal claim or date is asserted.
This is a separate scope or consent compliance episode, not the infection-control activity in task 17357. Required-record writing and save have been split and retained before concluding zero.
Shares are illustrative, not a claimed record-writing baseline per patient. Routine cases without a required record should omit that record; no saving is manufactured from it.

s3 supplies the normal completed-record check for the requested exact-version commit gate. No new approval queue or save saving. A statutory filing or external notification would need its own actual workflow and is not assumed here.
research_questions: What concrete repeated activity, if any, is currently reducible without changing professional adherence?

already_counted.description: All source reading, compliance action, actual record writing and save remain unchanged.

incremental.description: No new system or process proposed.

approvals.approved_version: Exact required record checked in s3

time_saved_range_pct.basis: All separately examined steps remain at 100%; no demonstrated new reducible work or incremental system.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Assess the patient's actual history, concerns, relevant examination findings and available prior care records in conversation and examination.
Develop individual treatment plans and strategies within the practitioner's scope, including deciding whether further conventional clinical assessment is needed.
Discuss the proposed plan, uncertainties and patient preferences and agree the actual next steps with the patient.
outputs: Actual agreed plan or decision not to proceed

steps.what: Write the agreed treatment plan into the clinical record {OTHER}, including actual assessment details and the patient's decision.
outputs: Draft individual plan in the clinical record system

steps.what: Check the completed plan, patient identity and intended patient-copy destination against the actual assessment and agreement.
outputs: Checked exact final plan and patient-copy destination

steps.what: Commit the checked individual treatment plan in the clinical record {OTHER}.
Send that checked plan copy to the verified patient destination through the clinical record system's patient portal {OTHER}.
outputs: Patient receives the exact plan copy

tasks.design: Configure the native clinical plan form to reuse existing identity and administrative fields. The practitioner supplies all new assessment and plan content, with no generated treatment choice. Keep final checking, save and patient-copy send separate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated entry of existing patient and administrative fields in the plan form.
tasks.enabler_now: Native clinical record form defaults and approved fixed headings.
tasks.still_hard: Patient-specific suitability, uncertainty and referral decisions.
tasks.human_edge: Assessing the patient and agreeing a responsible plan.

ambition.what: Support documentation of the existing human-developed plan.

tasks.altitude: Clinical judgment and patient agreement remain human.

evidence.claim: Native clinical forms can reuse existing administrative fields while the practitioner authors the individual plan.

assumptions: Conditional E1 example where repeated administrative entry exists. No saving if already populated. The 12% writing step retains all patient-specific content; no ambient transcript or clean assessment note is assumed.
The episode includes an existing patient-copy practice, with its real send separately shown. No clinical intervention or referral transmission is included in the plan-development saving.

s5 is the normal final clinical check after the full plan exists, not an extra self-approval. Exact-version gates bind record save and patient-copy send; edits require recheck. Both action tails remain fully retained.
research_questions: Do native defaults reduce actual plan entry without carrying stale patient-specific content?

already_counted.description: Assessment, plan choice, discussion, individual writing, full final check and both actions remain counted.

incremental.description: Maintain form defaults and test patient identity mapping after updates.

approvals.approved_version: Exact individual plan checked in s5
Exact plan copy and patient destination checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 12 x 20% = 2.4 gross points less 0.5 upkeep = 1.9; high rounded down to 1.5. No clinical or transmission saving claimed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Retrieve the patient's prior recorded treatment outcomes and dates in the clinical record system {OTHER}.
outputs: Source-linked prior outcomes with missing data visible

steps.what: Evaluate treatment outcomes through actual patient conversation and assessment of reported response, adverse effects and current concerns.
Judge the response and decide whether new or altered treatments, stopping care or further clinical evaluation should be recommended within professional scope.
Discuss the recommendation and uncertainties with the patient and establish their actual response and next-step agreement.
outputs: Actual discussed recommendation and patient response

steps.what: Write the actual outcome assessment, recommendation and patient response in the clinical record {OTHER}, then check the final entry against this encounter.
inputs: Actual information from s2 and s4

steps.what: Commit the checked outcome assessment and recommendation entry in the clinical record {OTHER}.

tasks.design: Configure a native dated outcome view for already recorded observations. It shortens finding prior entries; it neither measures the current outcome nor recommends treatment. Keep actual interview, assessment, decisions, dialogue and record writing.
tasks.previous_blocker: Prior outcomes are scattered among chronological encounters.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing clinical record filters and trends can display source entries together.
tasks.still_hard: Attributing change and deciding when a different clinical pathway is needed.
tasks.human_edge: Recognising concerning developments and discussing uncertainty with the patient.

evidence.claim: Native clinical record filters can reduce retrieval of existing outcome entries without automating current clinical evaluation.

assumptions: E1 active-work allocation for a follow-up episode distinct from initial plan development. No double credit for the same encounter or record.
Only existing recorded entries can populate s1; missing or inconsistent records require manual reading. The current patient information is actually elicited in s2, not assumed to arrive structured.

s5 writes and checks the actual encounter entry. Its ordinary final check gates the exact fully retained save; no added self-approval. A treatment order, referral or external message would be a separate gated workflow, not hidden in this recommendation.
research_questions: Does the native view preserve dates, sources and missingness without implying treatment efficacy?

already_counted.description: Prior-source checking, current assessment, judgment, discussion, actual note and save remain counted.

incremental.description: Check outcome-view mappings after record changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact actual follow-up entry checked in s5

time_saved_range_pct.basis: 10 x 30% retrieval reduction = 3 gross points minus 0.5 upkeep. Already consolidated records give zero; no efficacy claim is made.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The practitioner retains patient assessment, treatment decisions and safety responsibilities.
role.ambitious_version: An acupuncturist with clearer records and less repeated lookup, while patient-specific care remains human.
